rationale.conceptual: The method is standard LDA-DFT using Quantum ESPRESSO, an established plane-wave code. Constructing stacking-fault supercells in the Hägg notation requires some attention, but no novel algorithms are needed.
rationale.execution: The workflow has four distinct stages: supercell generation, multiple DFT relaxations (up to ~14 separate runs), and two post-processing steps. This constitutes a multi-stage pipeline with several handoffs, though all steps use standard tools.

difficulty.reasoning: The task reproduces standard LDA-DFT formation energy calculations for twin boundaries and stacking faults. The method is well-established, requiring routine supercell construction and batch DFT runs. Execution involves a moderate four-step pipeline with multiple geometry optimizations, but no exotic tooling.

compute_estimate.reasoning: CPU-bound DFT geometry optimizations on 120-atom supercells with plane-wave LDA; each relaxation may consume a few GB of RAM. Input data is limited to pseudopotential files and structure definitions.
